description: A depiction of a gold-coloured Sentinel-3 Earth observation satellite in orbit, showing a blue solar array extending to the left and a curved segment of Earth visible at the bottom. Two key instruments are highlighted and labelled: the Ocean and Land Colour Instrument (OLCI), indicated by green text "OLCI" and a green circle around the satellite's top section; and the Sea and Land Surface Temperature Radiometer (SLSTR), indicated by red text "SLSTR" with a red arrow pointing to and a red rectangle outlining a section on the side of the satellite body.
